title: Northbeam TechWorks Quality Standard: Completion, Rework and Workmanship
content:
Work on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is recorded complete only where the service requires no sign-off, or where the customer's sign-off is on file for that agreement. The sign-off is read from the record held against that agreement, not taken from the customer's word at the door.

Photographs of the finished work are kept where the service requires them, and a job completed without them is not refused but is flagged for the supervisor.

## The rework window

A rework job is raised without charge only within the service's rework window, counted from the day the original work was signed off. The rework window is counted in calendar days from the completion day, which counts as day zero. The completion day is read from the work order, the comparison is not-later-than, and a rework raised on the last day the window allows is within it.

> **On a service whose window runs sixty days.** The completion day counts as day zero. A rework raised on day sixty falls on the last day the window allows and is raised without charge; one raised on day sixty-one falls outside the window and is not raised without charge on this basis.

Rework inside the window is carried out without labour or crew attendance charges where the service makes rework free, and parts are still billed unless the part itself failed.

## The workmanship period

The retailer stands behind the workmanship for the service's guarantee days, which run alongside the rework window and are not shortened by it. A fault arising from the item rather than the work is a protection plan or warranty matter instead.

## Repeated rework on one item

Where the profile has raised rework repeatedly on the same item — counted as the rework jobs raised on the profile over the rolling twelve calendar months ending on the handling date — the job is escalated to a senior technician rather than reworked a third time by the same crew.

## Damage caused during the work

Damage caused during the work is met up to the service's liability cap and is never set against the customer's own charges.

## Points of judgement

**A service requiring no sign-off.** Completion is recorded on the first limb of the rule, the service requiring no sign-off; nothing on the appointment record is needed for it.

**A service requiring sign-off, with none on file.** Neither limb is satisfied, so the work is not recorded complete.

**Photographs missing where the service requires them.** Completion is not refused; the job is flagged for the supervisor.

The per-service figures this standard reads — the rework window, whether rework inside it is free, the workmanship period, whether sign-off is required, whether photographs are kept, the calibration passes included in one visit and the liability cap — are carried in the quality, entitlement and settlement schedules for the six TechWorks services.
